distractors: The read cache holds entries for five seconds, which adds its own staleness window on top of whatever the write path costs.
Queue depth and pass duration are exported but no alert threshold or target is stated for either.
property: The projector applies queued charges on a fixed thirty-second schedule, so a charge posted just after a pass waits for the next one and can be absent from a ledger read for close to half a minute. The accepted proposal commits to the charge being readable within two seconds of posting. Neither document says this; it follows from combining the schedule with the commitment.
summary: A batching interval and an accepted freshness commitment are individually reasonable and cannot both hold; no sentence in either document contradicts the other.
